executionDefinition.source:

# catalog metadata and prices retain their aggregator provenance.

# Inference controls are endpoint contracts, separate from catalog model facts.
inference = { reasoning = "anthropic", fast = "speed", enabled_requires_budget = true, fast_beta = "fast-mode-2026-02-01" }
features = { thinking = "supported", mode_support = { enabled = { forced_tool_choice = "unsupported" } }, budget = { support = "supported", dynamic = "unsupported" }, effort = { support = "supported" }, fast = "supported", sources = ["https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking"], requirements = ["Fast mode requires preview access and an eligible model."] }
pricing_info = { currencies = ["USD"], units = ["per_million_tokens"], dimensions = ["model", "service_tier", "submission", "input_tokens", "time"], sources = ["https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing"] }

regions = ["international"]
provider_id = "anthropic"
base_url = "https://api.anthropic.com"
protocol = "anthropic_messages"
decisions = { implementation = "structured_output", text = true, image = true }
auth = "api_key"
credential_env = "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
billing_mode = "per_token"

display_name = "Anthropic"
description = "First-party Claude models over the Messages API."

# Prices and descriptive metadata: models.dev via aggregator.
# Old aggregator IDs are local aliases, never sent to the first-party endpoint.

extra = { web_search = "anthropic" }

reasoning = true
structured_output = true
temperature = false
attachment = true

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.description: First-party OpenAI models over the Responses API.

executionDefinition.source:
connection = { protocol_profiles = { open_ai_chat = "openai-chat" } }
embeddings = { mode = "enabled", value = { api = "open_ai", endpoint = "https://api.openai.com/v1/embeddings", models_endpoint = "https://api.openai.com/v1/models", auth = { type = "bearer" }, max_inputs = 2048 } }
retrieval = { mode = "enabled", value = { api = "open_ai", endpoint = "https://api.openai.com/v1/vector_stores", auth = { type = "bearer" } } }
batches = { mode = "enabled", value = { api = "open_ai", endpoint = "https://api.openai.com/v1/batches", files_endpoint = "https://api.openai.com/v1/files", auth = { type = "bearer" } } }
background = { mode = "enabled", value = { endpoint = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses", auth = { type = "bearer" } } }
audio = { mode = "enabled", value = { transcriptions_endpoint = "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions", translations_endpoint = "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/translations", speech_endpoint = "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech", auth = { type = "bearer" } } }
# First-party OpenAI speaks the Responses API; the Chat Completions wire is what
# the compatible providers use, not this one.

# Inference controls are endpoint contracts, separate from catalog model facts.
inference = { reasoning = "open_ai_responses", fast = "fast" }
features = { thinking = "supported", budget = { support = "unsupported", dynamic = "unsupported" }, effort = { support = "supported" }, fast = "supported", sources = ["https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/reasoning"] }
pricing_info = { currencies = ["USD"], units = ["per_million_tokens"], dimensions = ["model", "service_tier", "submission", "input_tokens", "time"], sources = ["https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing"] }

regions = ["international"]
provider_id = "openai"
base_url = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
protocol = "open_ai_responses"
decisions = { implementation = "structured_output", text = true, image = true }
# The completion wire and the model directory are different things here:
# this vendor serves one shared model list for both of its wires, in the
# other one's shape. Left unstated, a refresh would look for a directory in
# this wire's shape, which is not published at all.
model_list = "open_ai_chat"
auth = "bearer"
credential_env = "OPENAI_API_KEY"
billing_mode = "per_token"

display_name = "OpenAI"
description = "First-party OpenAI models over the Responses API."
console_url = "https://platform.openai.com"
api_key_url = "https://platform.openai.com/api-keys"
docs_url = "https://developers.openai.com/api/docs"
credential_hint = "sk-"

# OpenAI stores Responses objects and accepts their ids to continue a chain.
# This is opt-in because several otherwise Responses-compatible endpoints
# accept the field but ignore it.
extra = { supports_previous_response_id = true, web_search = "openai_responses", code_interpreter = "openai_responses", remote_mcp = "openai_responses" }

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.description: An aggregator: one key, many vendors' models, one wire.

executionDefinition.source:
connection = { protocol_profiles = { open_ai_responses = "openrouter-responses", anthropic_messages = "openrouter-anthropic" } }
embeddings = { mode = "enabled", value = { api = "open_router", endpoint = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/embeddings", models_endpoint = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/embeddings/models", auth = { type = "bearer" } } }
# An aggregator: one key, many vendors' models, all over one OpenAI-compatible
# wire. Its catalog is by far the largest here, which is the nature of the thing
# rather than a mistake.
#
# Read `[model.pricing.batch]` here with more care than on a first-party preset.
# An aggregator quotes the cheapest host it can route to, and the batch rate it
# publishes may come from a different host than the listed one — for eleven
# models here the "batch" rate is dearer than the interactive rate, up to 4x on
# the open-weights ones. Those pairs are not a discount, they are two sellers.
# The numbers are carried as published; nothing here assumes batch is cheaper.
#
# A `:free` id is this vendor's own marker for a model served at no charge, and
# unlike `:batch` it is a real wire id. Those models carry
# `billing_mode = "free"` so failover will not quietly move a free request onto
# a metered sibling. The route's `per_token` below is the default for everything
# that does not say otherwise.
#
# "Free" is not inferred from a zero price anywhere, and must not be: several
# models here and on other presets are priced at zero because a subscription
# already covers them. Those are covered, not free.
#
# What this does not model: the free tier carries its own request-rate caps,
# which the catalog does not publish.

# Inference controls are endpoint contracts, separate from catalog model facts.
inference = { reasoning = "reasoning_object", fast = "priority" }
features = { thinking = "supported", budget = { support = "supported", dynamic = "unsupported" }, effort = { support = "supported" }, fast = "supported", sources = ["https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/best-practices/reasoning-tokens"] }
pricing_info = { currencies = ["USD"], units = ["per_million_tokens"], dimensions = ["model", "service_tier", "submission", "input_tokens", "time"], sources = ["https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/features/service-tiers"] }

regions = ["international"]
provider_id = "openrouter"
base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"
protocol = "open_ai_chat"
auth = "api_key"
credential_env = "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"
billing_mode = "per_token"

display_name = "OpenRouter"
description = "An aggregator: one key, many vendors' models, one wire."
console_url = "https://openrouter.ai"
api_key_url = "https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys"
docs_url = "https://openrouter.ai/docs"
credential_hint = "sk-or-"

extra = { web_search = "openrouter" }

id = "openrouter/auto"
name = "Auto Router"
description = "The Auto Router automatically selects the best model for your prompt, powered by the wisdom of the market. It routes you based on what the OpenRouter community collectively spends on..."
